# MANOVIK AI

> MANOVIK AI is an autonomous AI agent that codes in any language, builds websites, apps, and APIs, and works for you 24/7.

MANOVIK AI is an autonomous AI agent that plans, builds and ships websites, apps and APIs. It is a streaming, polyglot coding agent with reasoning, private threads, and rich markdown output. Threads are encrypted at rest and never used to train third-party models.

## Pricing

- Free tier: start building without a card.
- MANOVIK AI Pro: 800 messages with one-time payment, for builders shipping daily. Price: 699 INR (one-time, not a subscription).
- MANOVIK AI Sovereign (Lifetime Self-Host): run MANOVIK on your own infrastructure forever. One-time payment. Price: 4999 INR. Includes the self-host setup wizard, Docker support, and BYOK (bring your own key).
